evidence: Touches peer message handling for block relay, specifically handling MSG_BLOCK requests, and carries the P2P label.
rationale: Optimizes legacy block relay by avoiding deserialization and reserialization when serving `MSG_BLOCK`. Author benchmarks report disk read and message creation dropping from 3.47 ms to 0.374 ms (~9.3x speedup) for witness-bearing blocks, though legacy block serving is not the primary modern sync path.
